subject: Harden SENTINEL commands and config rewrite against control-character injection (#3847)
reason: The change is entirely inside src/sentinel.c and only executes when valkey-server runs in Sentinel mode: sentinelValidateArgs guards SENTINEL SET / SENTINEL MONITOR / SENTINEL CONFIG SET, and the sdscatrepr escaping runs in rewriteConfigSentinelOption, which rewrites sentinel state. Sentinel mode is enabled only by the --sentinel command-line argument or a valkey-sentinel executable name (checkForSentinelMode, src/server.c:7267), never by a config option; on a normal server the SENTINEL command is not even registered (CMD_ONLY_SENTINEL, src/server.c:3354) and a 'sentinel' directive in a config
